# x402-plugin-template

Build a Claude Code (or OpenClaw) plugin that consumes an x402-gated MCP service. This template handles the messy parts: connection lifecycle, the `402 → sign → retry` round-trip, payment confirmation UX, and packaging for both runtimes.

GitHub: [`x402-plugin-template`](https://github.com/MangroveTechnologies/x402-plugin-template).

## Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MangroveTechnologies/x402-plugin-template.git my-plugin
cd my-plugin
./init.sh my-plugin-name https://my-server.com/mcp
```

The init script:
1. Renames the package and references.
2. Wires the MCP server URL into `shared/config.ts`.
3. Removes the example skills and gives you a stub.

Then customize:
- `.claude/skills/` — Claude Code slash commands
- `openclaw-plugin/` — OpenClaw plugin manifest + handlers
- `shared/` — code that both runtimes share (MCP client, x402 round-trip, formatting)

## x402 round-trip — handled for you

The template's MCP client wraps every tool call:

1. Call tool without `payment` parameter.
2. Server returns `402 Payment Required` with price and network details.
3. Plugin prompts the user for confirmation.
4. Plugin signs the payment with the configured wallet.
5. Plugin re-calls the tool with the `payment` parameter (base64 signature).
6. Server verifies, settles on-chain, returns the data.

You write the slash command logic; the template handles steps 2-5.

## Reference plugins built from this template

- [mangrove-trader-plugins](https://github.com/MangroveTechnologies/mangrove-trader-plugins) — wraps MangroveTrader.
- The MangroveMarkets plugin uses an evolved fork of this template that predates the public release.
